title: A Winter for the Hymn
author: Rafael Nakamura
blurb: Marguerite Almeida, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, has spent fifteen years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
